en: FLORINIA: Your timing is most opportune, \PN.

en: I've been chasing these two around for a while now...

en: The present moment yet proves ideal to finish the task once and for all.
ja: この機会に決着をつけるのが最適でしょう。

key: Will you join me?

key: This speaker has been pursuing the given duo for an unprofessional amount of time.

ja: この話者は当該の二体を専門家らしからぬ時間にわたって追跡している。

en: Tell-tale signs of fatigue are observable in both parties.
ja: 両者ともに疲労の兆候が明確に観察される。

key: LATIAS: -There!-
en: LATIAS: -There!-
ja: ラティアス: -やった!-

key: -You should be able to understand me telepathically now!-
en: -You should be able to understand me telepathically now!-
ja: -これでテレパシーで通じ合えるはずよ!-

key: -As I was saying, we have to find them quickly!-
en: -As I was saying, we have to find them quickly!-
ja: -さっきも言った通り、早く二人を見つけなきゃ!-

key: -The human's repressed emotions have corrupted the unnatural energy around Latios and caused it to go haywire and affect her, too!-
en: -The human's repressed emotions have corrupted the unnatural energy around Latios and caused it to go haywire and affect her, too!-
ja: -人間の抑圧された感情が、ラティオスの周りの異常なエネルギーをゆがめて、暴走させて彼女にも影響を与えているの!-

key: -If we act quickly, we can save them both!-
en: -If we act quickly, we can save them both!-
ja: -すぐに動けば、二人とも助けられるはず!-

key: -Follow me!-
en: -Follow me!-
ja: -ついてきて!-

key: LATIAS: -Human!-
en: LATIAS: -Human!-
ja: ラティアス: -人間!-

key: -Fragments of that other human should be scattered around this place!-
en: -Fragments of that other human should be scattered around this place!-
ja: -あのもう一人の人間の断片が、この場所のあちこちに散らばっているはずよ!-

key: -Until she learns to accept these different parts of herself, there's no way we'll be able to rescue her or Latios!-
en: -Until she learns to accept these different parts of herself, there's no way we'll be able to rescue her or Latios!-
ja: -彼女がこの様々な自分自身の部分を受け入れられるようにならない限り、彼女もラティオスも救い出せない!-

key: -You have to help her!-
en: -You have to help her!-
ja: -彼女を助けてあげて!-

key: -Find her, and find a way to help her understand the emotions she's disconnected herself from!-
en: -Find her, and find a way to help her understand the emotions she's disconnected herself from!-
ja: -彼女を見つけて、彼女が自分から切り離してしまった感情を理解する手助けをして!-

key: -You can understand me because of my power, but in order to get through to her, you'll have to speak the language of emotions too!-
en: -You can understand me because of my power, but in order to get through to her, you'll have to speak the language of emotions too!-
ja: -あなたは私の力のおかげで私の言葉がわかるけど、彼女に伝わるには、あなたも感情の言葉を話せるようにならなきゃ!-

key: -If you look around this place, you can surely find some hints as to how to translate from one to the other!-
en: -If you look around this place, you can surely find some hints as to how to translate from one to the other!-
ja: -この場所を見回れば、きっと一方からもう一方へ訳すヒントが見つかるはず!-

key: -Remember, when you're trying to understand emotions, the key is to stop, wait, and pay attention!-
en: -Remember, when you're trying to understand emotions, the key is to stop, wait, and pay attention!-
ja: -覚えておいて、感情を理解しようとするときの鍵は、立ち止まって、待って、注意を払うことよ!-

key: -If you need help, you can ask me too!-
en: -If you need help, you can ask me too!-
ja: -助けが必要なら、私にも聞いていいから!-

key: -How can I help?!-
en: -How can I help?!-
ja: -どうやって助ければいい?!-

key: LATIAS: -In order to save the other human and Latios, we need to piece the fractured parts of that girl back together!-
en: LATIAS: -In order to save the other human and Latios, we need to piece the fractured parts of that girl back together!-
ja: ラティアス: -あのもう一人の人間とラティオスを救うには、あの子の砕けた部分をつなぎ合わせないと!-

key: -Help her understand her emotions by telling her what she's feeling!-
en: -Help her understand her emotions by telling her what she's feeling!-
ja: -彼女が今何を感じているかを伝えて、感情を理解する手助けをして!-

key: -But in her state, she can't understand you normally!-
en: -But in her state, she can't understand you normally!-
ja: -でも今の彼女の状態じゃ、普通に話しても伝わらない!-

key: -You have to translate her feeling into the language of emotions!-
en: -You have to translate her feeling into the language of emotions!-
ja: -彼女の気持ちを、感情の言葉に訳してあげなきゃ!-

key: -There are clues all throughout this place that will help you do that!-
en: -There are clues all throughout this place that will help you do that!-
ja: -この場所のあちこちに、それを助けてくれる手がかりがある!-

key: -But in order to find them, you'll have to stop, wait and listen!-
en: -But in order to find them, you'll have to stop, wait and listen!-
ja: -でもそれを見つけるには、立ち止まって、待って、耳を澄まさなきゃ!-

key: -Sometimes it's just like that when someone's locked their emotions deep away inside of themselves!-
en: -Sometimes it's just like that when someone's locked their emotions deep away inside of themselves!-
ja: -誰かが自分の感情を心の奥深くに閉じ込めてしまったときって、こんな感じになることがあるの!-

key: -I can also give you an idea of the many things that humans might be feeling, in order to help you understand what to tell her!-
en: -I can also give you an idea of the many things that humans might be feeling, in order to help you understand what to tell her!-
ja: -人間が感じるかもしれないいろんなことについても教えてあげられるから、彼女に何を伝えればいいかわかるはずよ!-

key: -Just ask if you need more help!-
en: -Just ask if you need more help!-
ja: -もっと助けが必要なら聞いて!-

key: LATIAS: -There are many things that humans can feel, and even more that Pokémon like us can!-
en: LATIAS: -There are many things that humans can feel, and even more that Pokémon like us can!-
ja: ラティアス: -人間が感じられるものはたくさんあって、私たちみたいなポケモンならもっとある!-

key: -I'm sure Latios was swept away in the whirlwind of things that human has locked inside her!-
en: -I'm sure Latios was swept away in the whirlwind of things that human has locked inside her!-
ja: -きっとラティオスは、あの人間が心の奥に閉じ込めていたものの渦に巻き込まれてしまったんだと思う!-

key: -To give you an idea of some possibilities...-
en: -To give you an idea of some possibilities...-
ja: -いくつか例を挙げると……-

key: -Shock, Anxiety, Grief, Sorrow, Fear, Envy, Guilt, Passion, Confidence, Emptiness, Pride, Joy, Love, Disgust, Anger, Apathy...-
en: -Shock, Anxiety, Grief, Sorrow, Fear, Envy, Guilt, Passion, Confidence, Emptiness, Pride, Joy, Love, Disgust, Anger, Apathy...-
ja: -衝撃、不安、悲嘆、悲しみ、恐れ、嫉妬、罪悪感、情熱、自信、空虚、誇り、喜び、愛、嫌悪、怒り、無関心……-

key: -There are many more things that humans can feel, but let's focus on these for now!-
en: -There are many more things that humans can feel, but let's focus on these for now!-
ja: -人間が感じられるものは他にもたくさんあるけど、今はこれらに絞りましょう!-

key: -When someone has really disconnected, it can help to look at a menu of what one might feel in order to ascertain what they ARE feeling!-
en: -When someone has really disconnected, it can help to look at a menu of what one might feel in order to ascertain what they ARE feeling!-
ja: -誰かが本当に感情から切り離されてしまったときは、何を感じているかを見極めるために、感じ得るものの一覧を見るのが役に立つの!-

key: -But that human can't do that right now, so you have to help!-
en: -But that human can't do that right now, so you have to help!-
ja: -でもあの人間は今それができないから、あなたが手伝わなきゃ!-

key: FLORINIA: The patient displays accelerated breathing, quickened nervous reaction and impaired cognitive functioning.
en: FLORINIA: The patient displays accelerated breathing, quickened nervous reaction and impaired cognitive functioning.
ja: フロリニア: 患者は呼吸の加速、神経反応のこう進、認知機能の低下を示している。

key: Additional symptoms include tensing of the muscles, furrowing of the brow, additional pressure exerted on the jaw, and a predisposition to clenched fists.
en: Additional symptoms include tensing of the muscles, furrowing of the brow, additional pressure exerted on the jaw, and a predisposition to clenched fists.
ja: その他の症状として、筋肉の緊張、眉間のしわ、顎への過度な力、拳を握りしめる傾向が挙げられる。

key: Subject describes a non-literal burning sensation within her chest, and has difficulty focusing on tasks unrelated to the source stimuli.
en: Subject describes a non-literal burning sensation within her chest, and has difficulty focusing on tasks unrelated to the source stimuli.
ja: 被験者は胸の内側に比喩的な焼けるような感覚を訴えており、刺激源と無関係な作業への集中が困難な状態にある。

key: FLORINIA: ...Very well.
en: FLORINIA: ...Very well.
ja: フロリニア: ……なるほど。

key: Diagnosis acknowledged.
en: Diagnosis acknowledged.
ja: 診断を了承。

key: Subject is afflicted with "Anger".
en: Subject is afflicted with "Anger".
ja: 被験者は「怒り」に冒されている。

key: This writer observes this "Anger" may yet be a defensible survival skill, providing impetus for the subject to remove herself from and challenge unfavorable circumstances.
en: This writer observes this "Anger" may yet be a defensible survival skill, providing impetus for the subject to remove herself from and challenge unfavorable circumstances.
ja: この記述者は、この「怒り」がなお正当な生存戦略でありうると考える。被験者が不利な状況から自身を切り離し、それに立ち向かうための原動力を与えるものとして。

key: Studies show that repression of anger may produce negative effects such as chronic pain, digestive issues and tension headaches.
en: Studies show that repression of anger may produce negative effects such as chronic pain, digestive issues and tension headaches.
ja: 研究によれば、怒りの抑圧は慢性的な痛み、消化器系の不調、緊張性頭痛などの悪影響を生じさせうるとされている。

key: Suppression of this survival mechanism may yet be inadvisable due to its motivating effects and adverse psychosomatic consequences under suppression.
en: Suppression of this survival mechanism may yet be inadvisable due to its motivating effects and adverse psychosomatic consequences under suppression.
ja: この生存機構の抑圧は、その動機づけ効果と、抑圧下における心身への悪影響を考慮すれば、推奨されない可能性がある。

key: The subject may have residual anger towards past associates for mistreatment and subsequent abandonment.
en: The subject may have residual anger towards past associates for mistreatment and subsequent abandonment.
ja: 被験者は、過去の関係者による不当な扱いとその後の見捨てに対し、なお残留する怒りを抱いている可能性がある。

key: This is... perhaps, acceptable.
en: This is... perhaps, acceptable.
ja: これは……おそらく、許容範囲だろう。

key: FLORINIA: Diagnosis mismatched.
en: FLORINIA: Diagnosis mismatched.
ja: フロリニア: 診断不一致。

key: Results yet inconclusive.
en: Results yet inconclusive.
ja: 結果はいまだ不確定。

en: FLORINIA: The patient reports a consistent sinking feeling within their chest cavity.
ja: フロリニア: 患者は胸部内に一貫した沈むような感覚を訴えている。

key: No foreign objects or weights could be identified.
en: No foreign objects or weights could be identified.
ja: 異物や重りは確認できなかった。

key: Patient exerts a proclivity to look downward, and movements and energy both appear to be inhibited at varying degrees.
en: Patient exerts a proclivity to look downward, and movements and energy both appear to be inhibited at varying degrees.
ja: 患者は下方を見る傾向を示し、動作とエネルギーの双方が、程度は様々ながら抑制されているように見える。

key: The subject has been observed as occasionally producing moisture from their eyes, or sharp exhalation of unusual strength.
en: The subject has been observed as occasionally producing moisture from their eyes, or sharp exhalation of unusual strength.
ja: 被験者は時折、目から水分を分泌したり、異常に強い鋭い呼気を発したりすることが観察されている。

key: FLORINIA: ...Indeed.
en: FLORINIA: ...Indeed.
ja: フロリニア: ……確かに。

key: Subject is afflicted with "Sorrow".
en: Subject is afflicted with "Sorrow".
ja: 被験者は「悲しみ」に冒されている。

key: Defined as "a feeling of distress caused by loss, disappointment or misfortune"...
en: Defined as "a feeling of distress caused by loss, disappointment or misfortune"...
ja: 定義: 「喪失、失望、または不運によって引き起こされる苦悩の感情」……

key: While initially regarded as improbable that the subject should have any rational cause to adopt this afflict in lament of, it is perhaps reasonable nonetheless.
en: While initially regarded as improbable that the subject should have any rational cause to adopt this afflict in lament of, it is perhaps reasonable nonetheless.
ja: 当初は被験者がこの疾患を嘆く合理的な理由を持つとは考えにくいとされていたが、それでもなお、妥当である可能性はある。

key: Rationality may yet be unequal to the task of making judgments of value that will be beneficial to the subject.
en: Rationality may yet be unequal to the task of making judgments of value that will be beneficial to the subject.
ja: 合理性は、被験者にとって有益な価値判断を下すには、なお不十分であるかもしれない。

key: The patient's history does indicate a veritable record of loss and disappointment, with particular regard to former social circles and interpersonal comfort.
en: The patient's history does indicate a veritable record of loss and disappointment, with particular regard to former social circles and interpersonal comfort.
ja: 患者の経歴には、とりわけかつての交友関係や対人的な安らぎに関して、喪失と失望の記録が確かに見て取れる。

key: Very well,
en: Very well,
ja: わかりました、

key: We shall begin treatment for "Sorrow" posthaste.
en: We shall begin treatment for "Sorrow" posthaste.
ja: では「悲しみ」の治療を早速始めましょう。

key: -"O" becomes... "5"-
en: -"O" becomes... "5"-

key: FLORINIA: The subject appears to be suffering an especially irrational affliction now...
en: FLORINIA: The subject appears to be suffering an especially irrational affliction now...
ja: フロリニア: 被験者は今、特に不合理な症状に苦しんでいるようだ……

key: She reports feeling much lighter than normal, though all metrics indicate her body weight is unchanged.
en: She reports feeling much lighter than normal, though all metrics indicate her body weight is unchanged.
ja: 彼女は通常よりかなり体が軽く感じると訴えているが、あらゆる測定値は体重に変化がないことを示している。

key: The corners of her lips have forcibly been turned upwards, and her body appears to move with uncharacteristic looseness.
en: The corners of her lips have forcibly been turned upwards, and her body appears to move with uncharacteristic looseness.
ja: 口角が強制的に上向きにねじ曲げられ、体は普段にない緩みをもって動いているように見える。

key: At its most extreme, the patient is even prone to involuntarily emitting a cacophonous sound, disruptive to respiratory functions.
en: At its most extreme, the patient is even prone to involuntarily emitting a cacophonous sound, disruptive to respiratory functions.
ja: 最も極端な例では、患者は呼吸機能を妨げるような不協和音を無意識に発することすらある。

key: Even the best scientists in the field have yet to ascertain the evolutionary purpose of this bizarre phenomenon.
en: Even the best scientists in the field have yet to ascertain the evolutionary purpose of this bizarre phenomenon.
ja: この分野最高の科学者たちでさえ、この奇妙な現象の進化上の目的をいまだ解明できていない。

key: What could have happened...?
en: What could have happened...?
ja: 一体何が起きたというのか……?

key: FLORINIA: "Joy"?
en: FLORINIA: "Joy"?
ja: フロリニア: 「喜び」?

key: Impossible.
en: Impossible.
ja: ありえない。

key: No-- improbable.
en: No-- improbable.
ja: いや――可能性は低い。

key: I suppose for the sake of proper treatment, we must rule nothing out...
en: I suppose for the sake of proper treatment, we must rule nothing out...
ja: 適切な治療のためには、何も除外してはならないと考えるべきか……

key: But how could the subject have been exposed to and infected with "Joy"...?
en: But how could the subject have been exposed to and infected with "Joy"...?
ja: だが、どうすれば被験者が「喜び」にさらされ、感染しうるというのか……?

key: This is-- a disaster.
en: This is-- a disaster.
ja: これは――大惨事だ。
私は――

key: We must seek help at once.
en: We must seek help at once.
ja: すぐに助けを求めなければ。

key: -"R" becomes... "@"-
en: -"R" becomes... "@"-

key: -It's working!-
en: -It's working!-
ja: -うまくいってる!-

key: -By helping her understand what she's feeling, we've moved even deeper into her heart!-
en: -By helping her understand what she's feeling, we've moved even deeper into her heart!-
ja: -彼女が感じていることを理解する手助けをすることで、彼女の心のもっと深くまで入り込めた!-

key: -But it's truly a shame... Why has she only acknowledged negative emotions so far?!-
en: -But it's truly a shame... Why has she only acknowledged negative emotions so far?!-
ja: -でも本当に残念……どうして今まで、彼女はネガティブな感情ばかり認めてきたの?!-

key: -If I can still help, say the word!-
en: -If I can still help, say the word!-
ja: -まだ手助けできるなら、言ってね!-

key: -"V" becomes... "T"-
en: -"V" becomes... "T"-
ja: -「V」は……「T」になる-

key: -"W" becomes... "#"-
en: -"W" becomes... "#"-

key: FLORINIA: The patient appears to be wholely consumed by a new syndrome.
en: FLORINIA: The patient appears to be wholely consumed by a new syndrome.
ja: フロリニア: 患者は新たな症候群にすっかり支配されているようだ。

key: Her pupils have dilated, and she appears to need to lean forward at all times as if pulled in by something.
en: Her pupils have dilated, and she appears to need to lean forward at all times as if pulled in by something.
ja: 瞳孔が開き、何かに引っ張られているかのように、常に前かがみになる必要があるように見える。

key: The patient reports single-minded purposeness-- a proclivity to dedicate herself entirely to and be possessed of a given task.
en: The patient reports single-minded purposeness-- a proclivity to dedicate herself entirely to and be possessed of a given task.
ja: 患者は一意専心な目的意識――ある課題に自らを完全にささげ、それに取りつかれる傾向を報告している。

key: Most regrettably, the specifics of said task seem to be out of her control-- or else this affliction might have been a fortuitous development for productivity.
en: Most regrettably, the specifics of said task seem to be out of her control-- or else this affliction might have been a fortuitous development for productivity.
ja: 最も遺憾なことに、その課題の具体的な内容は彼女の制御が及ばないようだ――さもなければこの症状は生産性にとって幸運な発展となっていたかもしれない。

key: FLORINIA: ...Indeed?
en: FLORINIA: ...Indeed?
ja: フロリニア: ……本当に?

key: The patient has been diagnosed with "Passion"...
en: The patient has been diagnosed with "Passion"...
ja: 患者は「情熱」であると診断された……

key: A double-edged sword.
en: A double-edged sword.
ja: 諸刃の剣だ。

key: On one hand, even whimsically applied to the random subjects which this "Passion" seems to append itself to, it can prove a useful tool in many circumstances.
en: On one hand, even whimsically applied to the random subjects which this "Passion" seems to append itself to, it can prove a useful tool in many circumstances.
ja: 一方で、この「情熱」が付着するらしいランダムな対象に気まぐれに向けられたとしても、多くの状況で有用な道具となりうる。

key: Statistics indicate that following "Passion" may result in an overwhelmingly significant number of benefits, ranging from production to personal health.
en: Statistics indicate that following "Passion" may result in an overwhelmingly significant number of benefits, ranging from production to personal health.
ja: 統計によれば、「情熱」に従うことは生産性から個人の健康に至るまで、圧倒的に多くの恩恵をもたらす可能性がある。
